别名

  • Incubus Surge

あらすじ

“By my ‘Demon Power’ I make students gape-lust!”

This time has tentacles! The dark feast begins

Spermation/Seacoxx presents our 4th online novel game!

Powered up hentai for the fan – and newcomer – of digital novels!

Featuring the artwork of popular manga-ka “orico”, Incubus Surge

(Japanese title: Inma no Hadou) is a lurid adaptation of Gakumon Furuse’s hit online novel that received over 30,000 views/day – now enhanced with 119 total CGs and full female voice acting!

item.title: Parameter Remocon
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: SEACOXX
  • 発売日: 2015-10-11
  • スコア: 5.87/10 (18 人評価)
  • 日本語名: パラメータ・リモコン
  • 英語名: Parameter Remocon

别名

  • Parameter Remocon

あらすじ

Kotaro Etozawa has obtained a remote control for “affection”.

When he uses it, it dials up a girl’s desire for a boy. Easy to use, instant results.

It works handily on a classmate, the nurse, and his hot teacher…

Taking his pleasure, the story progresses…

This is a visual novel adaptation of a poplular web novel and covers the first eleven chapters of it.
